messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Output HTML from Shiny .R files
parts:
I'm not sure exactly what you're asking, but there are two ways to deploy Shiny apps: either on the web (in which case only the server needs R and Shiny installed; app users only need a web browser), or by distributing code and having them run the apps themselves (in which case anyone who wants to run the app needs R and Shiny).

Details on both methods are available here:
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#deployment-web
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#deployment-local

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Output HTML from Shiny .R files
parts: Sorry, that's not possible with Shiny--it's only for running with a live R instance. You may want to look into Clickme, there's also one that was demoed at the last Seattle useR meeting called PlayData but it isn't out yet (by a guy named at Microsoft named Jin-Young Kim, track him down if you want to learn more).
